tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Potholes Filling at selected reaches of cross roads in Vijayanagara 4th stage in Hootagalli CMC Limit

itemList.description: Providing, laying, spreading and compacting graded stone aggregate to wet mix macadam specification including premixing the Material with water at OMC in mechanical mix plant carriage of mixed Material by tipper to site, laying in uniform layers with paver/grader in sub-base / base course on well prepared surface and compacting with vibratory roller to achieve the desired density(PWD SR Vol-03, 2023-24, Item no. 4.17, Page No.26)

Patching of Deep Potholes using WBM Gr l & SDBC Gr lI 25mm thick:Patching of Deep Potholes 75mm thick by restoring the Granular Base course using material confirming to WBM Grade -I with 1ype Screenings standards wherever necessary by manual means including trimming the pothole to the required shape and size, cleaning the pothole, applying Prime Coat (SS1) at 0.70 kg per m2 over the WBM surface and covering the surface with SDBC 25mm thick including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification. (PWD Vol-3, SR 2023-24,Sl no. 10.15 (ii), Page No.93, Issue Rates approved by SE, PWD Bengaluru Circle on 04-07-2026)
